description: This Java class 'SelectionBuilder' provides a helper utility for constructing SQL selection clauses, managing table joins, and executing database queries, updates, and deletes in an Android environment. It simplifies building complex SQL statements through method chaining and internal state management.

classes.name: SelectionBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for building SQL selection clauses, managing table joins, and executing queries on an SQLiteDatabase in Android.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state for reuse of the builder.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Adds a SQL WHERE clause with optional arguments, combining multiple clauses with AND.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Sets the table name for the SQL query.

methods.name: assertTable
methods.description: Checks that a table has been set; throws exception if not.

methods.name: mapToTable
methods.description: Maps a column to a specific table for join operations.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Creates a custom column or subquery in the SQL SELECT statement.

methods.name: getSelection
methods.description: Returns the current SQL selection string.

methods.name: getSelectionArgs
methods.description: Returns the current selection arguments array.

methods.name: mapColumns
methods.description: Replaces column names with mapped SQL expressions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the builder's current state.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SELECT query on the database with specified columns and order.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a detailed SELECT query with grouping, having, and limit options.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Performs an UPDATE operation on the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE operation on the database.
